entity.summary: Multichain perpetual decentralized exchange on BNB Chain and Solana that announced a phased wind-down on 2026-10-15. Perpetual trading was scheduled to become reduce-only on 2026-10-20, with forced position closure on 2027-01-15 and DUSD redemptions and withdrawals closing on 2027-01-31.
entity.notes: Originally listed as active in July 2026. Multiple contemporaneous reports of StandX's 2026-10-15 wind-down announcement support limited classification as of 2026-10-22. Reduce-only began according to its announced schedule; direct live trading-mode checks have not been independently performed. Do not classify the exchange as dead or set death_date before final service termination is confirmed. DUSD redemption and issuer lifecycle are separate from the exchange status and belong in SOG. Earlier July evidence is historical, not current-status support.

events.title: StandX announces phased perpetual-exchange wind-down
events.description: StandX announced a phased closure of its perpetual trading and DUSD services. Perpetuals, including Universal Markets, were scheduled to enter reduce-only mode on October 20, 2026. Remaining positions are scheduled to close on January 15, 2027; DUSD redemption requests and withdrawals are scheduled to close on January 31, 2027. These future closures are not yet recorded as completed.
events.notes: Announcement date and milestones are supported by two contemporaneous reports referencing the operator announcement; an independently retrievable permanent official announcement URL was not established at review. The final shutdown remains future-dated as of 2026-10-22.

evidence.title: About StandX
evidence.notes: First-party documentation identifies StandX as a live mainnet perpetual DEX across BNB Chain and Solana, powered by yield-bearing DUSD and permissionless market infrastructure.

evidence.title: StandX protocol metrics
evidence.notes: Current protocol metrics report substantial non-zero 24-hour, 7-day, and 30-day perpetual volume together with TVL and open interest, supporting active classification.

evidence.title: StandX sets January closure and DUSD exit dates
evidence.notes: Contemporaneous report cites StandX's October 15 announcement at 06:06 UTC. Distinguishes October 20 reduce-only, January 15 forced settlement, and January 31 redemption and withdrawal dates; official original permalink needs follow-up.

evidence.title: StandX Begins Wind-Down, Ends Yield Payments and Rules Out a Token
evidence.notes: Secondary reporting on phased StandX wind-down; used to corroborate the scheduled trading and redemptions cutoff. Do not treat the future dates as completed.
